lessons.title: Sounding professional: soften and hedge
lessons.hi: Seedhi baat ko tameez se kehna

blocks.x: Office English mein seedha 'No' ya 'You are wrong' rude lagta hai. Native professionals baat ko **soften** karte hain — ye ek hi skill aapki English ko turant professional bana deti hai.

Professional (soft)

I think there is room for improvement here.

blocks.x: Hedging words
**might, could, would, perhaps, I think, it seems, a little, slightly, probably** — inse baat narm ho jaati hai aur galti hone par bhi aap safe rehte ho.
**'I think' ke saath 'but' ka use**: 'I think this is a good idea, but we may need more time.' Pehle agree, phir concern — ye formula har meeting mein kaam karta hai.

lessons.hi: Office mein jo shabd alag lagte hain

blocks.x: Kuch phrases India mein roz bole jaate hain par duniya ke baaki hisson mein confusing ya odd lagte hain. Ye galat nahi hain, par interview aur international teams mein **neutral English** better rehti hai.

lessons.title: Speaking with confidence: pace, pauses and stress
lessons.hi: Awaaz, ruk-ruk kar bolna aur zor dena

blocks.x: Aapko English samajh aati hai par bolte waqt ruk jaate ho — iska ilaaj bahut shabd nahi, **bolne ki technique** hai.
1. Dheere bolo, ruko, saans lo
Tez bolne se galtiyan badhti hain. **Dheere aur saaf** bolo. Comma ya full stop par ek chhota pause lo. Pause professional lagta hai — ghabrahat nahi.

items.en: Good morning. (pause) I am Rahul. (pause) I am a Java developer.
items.hi: नमस्ते। (रुकें) मैं राहुल हूँ। (रुकें) मैं Java developer हूँ।

items.en: First, I fixed the bug. (pause) Then, I wrote a test.
items.hi: पहले मैंने bug ठीक किया। (रुकें) फिर test लिखा।

items.en: I have two options. (pause) The first one is simple.
items.hi: मेरे पास दो विकल्प हैं। (रुकें) पहला आसान है।

blocks.x: 2. Key words par zor do (stress)
Sentence ke important words (noun, verb, number, negative) par zor do; chhote words (a, the, to, of) halke bolo. Isse awaaz natural aur samajhne mein aasan lagti hai.

items.en: I WANT to JOIN your COMpany.
items.hi: मैं आपकी company join करना चाहता हूँ।

items.en: The DEADline is FRIday, not MONday.

blocks.x: 3. Awaaz upar-neeche (intonation)
**Yes/No sawaal** ke end mein awaaz upar jaati hai: 'Are you READY? ↗'. **Wh- sawaal aur statement** ke end mein neeche: 'Where do you LIVE? ↘' 'I live in DELhi. ↘'.
4. Filler words kam karo
'Basically', 'actually', 'you know', 'like' bar-bar mat bolo. Rukna ho to **ek second chup raho** ya 'Let me think' bolo.
**Accent ki chinta mat karo.** Maksad *samjhe jaana* hai, native accent nahi. Dheere, saaf aur ruk-ruk kar bolne wala accent har office mein samjha jata hai.
Roz ka 5-minute exercise
Koi bhi paragraph uthao, phone par record karo, sunke dekho: kahan jaldi ki, kahan 'umm' aaya. Dobara record karo. 3 baar mein farak sunai dega. Bolo section ke 'Check' button se bhi dekh sakte ho.

opts: Dheere aur saaf bolna, pause lena

quiz.q: Stress kin words par dete hain?
Yes/No sawaal ke end mein awaaz?

opts: Ek second chup raho / Let me think

lessons.title: Letters and their names
lessons.hi: 26 letters ka naam kaise bolte hain

blocks.x: English mein **26 letters** hote hain. Inme **5 vowels** (a, e, i, o, u) aur **21 consonants** hain. Hindi mein jaise 'क ख ग' hota hai, waise hi English mein A B C hai — bas inka **naam** aur **awaaz** alag hoti hai.
Sabse pehle letters ke **naam** pakke karo. Kisi ko apna naam spell karke batana ho, phone par email bolna ho, ya form bharna ho — har jagah ye kaam aata hai.
Har word ke saath speaker button dabao aur dhyan se suno. Phir khud bolo. Sirf padhna kaafi nahi — **suno aur bolo**.
Apna naam spell karna
Koi poochhe 'How do you spell your name?' to har letter ka naam bolo.

items.en: How do you spell your name?
items.hi: आप अपना नाम कैसे spell करते हैं?

items.en: My email is rahul at gmail dot com.
items.hi: मेरा ईमेल rahul at gmail dot com है।
क्या आप ये spell कर सकते हैं?

blocks.x: Capital aur small letters
**Capital letter** (A, B, C) in jagah use hote hain: sentence ke shuru mein, naam ke shuru mein (Rahul, India, Delhi), aur **I** (main) hamesha capital. Baaki jagah small letters (a, b, c).

quiz.q: 'B' ka naam kaise bola jata hai?
English mein kul kitne letters hote hain?
Kaun sa letter hamesha capital likha jata hai jab uska matlab 'main' ho?
Naam ka pehla letter kaisa likhte hain?
quiz.why: Rahul, Delhi, India — naam ka pehla letter capital.
a, e, i, o, u — baaki sab consonants.

lessons.title: Sounds that are tricky for Hindi speakers
lessons.hi: V/W, th, z, aur school wali galti

blocks.x: Hindi bolne walon ko kuch awaazein English mein mushkil lagti hain. Ye lesson unhi ke baare mein hai. Dheere dheere practice karo — slow button se dheere suno.
1. V aur W alag hain
Hindi mein 'व' ek hi awaaz hai, par English mein do hain. **V**: upar ke daant neeche ke hont par rakho (vet, van). **W**: hont gol karo, daant mat lagao (wet, water).
2. 'th' ki do awaazein
'th' mein **jeebh (tongue) daanton ke beech** thodi nikalo. Ye न 'त' hai न 'द'. Do tarah ki awaaz: halki (**think, three, thank**) aur bhaari (**this, that, mother**).
3. S + consonant: shuru mein 'i' mat lagao
Hindi mein 'school' ko aksar 'इस्कूल' bol dete hain. English mein shuru mein sirf **s** hai: **sk**ool, **st**op, **sp**eak. Pehle 's' ko lamba kheencho, phir aage badho.
4. Z aur J alag hain
**Z** mein dant ke paas 'ज़' ki bhinbhinahat. **J** mein 'ज' jaisi awaaz. zoo (ज़ू) aur Jew nahi — zoo aur **juice** alag hain.
Roz 5 minute ek awaaz par practice karo. Apni awaaz record karke suno (Bolo section mein) — sabse tez sudhaar yahi se hota hai.

quiz.why: W mein hont gol hote hain, daant hont par nahi lagte.
S+k sidha: स्कूल, shuru mein 'i' nahi.
Jeebh daanton ke beech halki nikalte hain.

quiz.q: Kaun sa word 'V' se shuru hota hai?
quiz.why: 'very' V se shuru hota hai, baaki W se.

lessons.title: Reading new words: vowel patterns and silent letters
lessons.hi: Spelling dekh kar awaaz kaise pata kare

blocks.x: English mein spelling aur awaaz hamesha match nahi karte — par kuch **patterns** hain jo 80% words handle kar dete hain. Ye lesson wahi patterns sikhata hai.
Pattern 1: Magic E (lamba vowel)
Agar word ke end mein **e** ho (jo bola nahi jata), to pehla vowel apna **naam** bolta hai (lamba). Bina e ke vowel chhota hota hai.

items.en: The cap is on the table.

items.hi: मुझे उम्मीद है कि आप ठीक हैं।

blocks.x: Pattern 2: Do vowels saath-saath
**ee, ea** = 'ई' (meet, eat). **oo** = 'ऊ' (food) ya 'उ' (book). **ai, ay** = 'ए' (rain, day). **oa, ow** = 'ओ' (boat, show).
Pattern 3: Silent letters (jo bole nahi jate)
Stress: kaun si syllable zor se bolein
Lambe words mein ek hissa zyada zor se bola jata hai. Jaise **BANana → ba-NA-na**, **teacher → TEA-cher**, **computer → com-PU-ter**. Naya word seekhte hi suno — zor kahan hai, notice karo.

quiz.why: Magic e se pehla vowel apna naam bolta hai: केप.

quiz.q: 'knife' mein kaun sa letter silent hai?

quiz.why: Magic e ki wajah se bite = बाइट (lamba).

lessons.title: Pronouns: I, you, he, she, it, we, they

blocks.x: **Pronoun** wo chhota shabd hai jo naam ki jagah aata hai. 'Rahul is a boy. **He** is tall.' — yahan Rahul ki jagah **He**. Ye 7 shabd English ki neev hain, inhe pakka kar lo.

head: Pronoun
Matlab
Kab use karein
rows: Samne wale ke liye (ek ya kai)

items.hi: वह बैंक में काम करता है।

blocks.x: Hindi mein 'tum' aur 'aap' do hain, par English mein dono ke liye sirf **you**. Respect 'please', 'sir', 'madam' se dikhate hain.
Object pronouns: me, him, her, us, them
Jab pronoun kaam ka **receiver** ho (jis par kaam hota hai), to ye form lagta hai: I→**me**, he→**him**, she→**her**, we→**us**, they→**them**. 'You' aur 'it' badalte nahi.

blocks.why: Subject (kaam karne wala) ki jagah I/he aata hai, me/him nahi.

quiz.q: Apne liye hamesha kaun sa pronoun capital hota hai?

quiz.why: Jaanwar/cheez ke liye aam taur par 'It'.

lessons.title: am, is, are — the 'to be' verb
lessons.hi: 'hai/hoon/ho' ko English mein kya kehte hain

blocks.x: Hindi mein 'main student **hoon**', 'woh doctor **hai**' — ye 'hoon/hai/ho' English mein **am / is / are** banta hai. **Har English sentence mein verb zaroori hai**, isliye 'I student' galat hai — 'I **am** a student' sahi hai.
Short forms (bolchaal mein)
Bolte waqt hum chhota roop use karte hain: **I'm, he's, she's, it's, we're, you're, they're**.
Negative aur Question
Negative: verb ke baad **not** lagao. Question: verb ko **subject se pehle** laao.

blocks.why: English mein verb (am) ke bina sentence poora nahi hota.
He/She/It ke saath hamesha is.

quiz.why: Verb subject se pehle: Are you ready?

quiz.q: 'He is not here.' ka chhota roop?

lessons.title: a, an, the (articles)

blocks.x: Hindi mein articles nahi hote, isliye ye sabse zyada galti wali jagah hai. Teen chhote shabd, teen simple rule.
a aur an — 'koi ek' (pehli baar baat)

Ek ginti wali cheez ke liye **a/an** lagta hai. **a** vowel *sound* se pehle nahi, consonant sound se pehle: a book, a pen. **an** vowel *sound* (a, e, i, o, u awaaz) se pehle: an apple, an egg, an hour (h silent hai, isliye an!).

items.hi: यह एक विश्वविद्यालय है। (yoo-sound, isliye a)

blocks.x: the — 'wo khaas/jaani hui cheez'
Jab sunne wala jaanta ho ki kaun si cheez ki baat hai, tab **the**. Pehli baar: 'I saw **a** dog.' Phir: '**The** dog was big.'

items.en: I saw a movie. The movie was good.
items.hi: मैंने एक फ़िल्म देखी। वह फ़िल्म अच्छी थी।

blocks.x: Kab koi article nahi?
Aam baat, plural ya uncountable cheez ke saath: 'I like **music**.' 'Dogs are loyal.' 'I drink **water**.' Languages, meals, aur zyadatar naam bhi: 'I speak English.' 'We have lunch at one.'

blocks.why: Ginti wale noun (student) se pehle a/an lagta hai.
teacher consonant sound se shuru hota hai, to 'a'.

quiz.why: Apple vowel sound se shuru: an.
engineer vowel sound se shuru: an.

quiz.q: I saw a dog. ___ dog was big.
quiz.why: Pehle se mention hui cheez: The.
'hour' mein h silent, awaaz vowel jaisi: an hour.

lessons.title: Plural nouns

blocks.x: Ek cheez = **singular**, ek se zyada = **plural**. Zyadatar words mein plural banane ke liye bas **-s** lagta hai.

head: Rule
Singular
Plural
rows: s, x, ch, sh, o ke baad -es

blocks.x: Kuch ulte-seedhe (irregular) plural
Jo count nahi hote (uncountable)
**water, rice, milk, money, news, information, advice, furniture, work, hair** — inka plural (-s) nahi banta, aur 'a/an' bhi nahi lagta. 'Much' aur 'some' lagta hai.

blocks.why: Information uncountable hai: informations nahi.

lessons.title: this, that, these, those

blocks.x: Kisi cheez ki taraf ishara karne ke liye 4 shabd. Do cheezein dekho: **paas ya door** aur **ek ya kai**.
Noun ke saath
Spelling: **this** (दिस) mein chhota 'इ', **these** (दीज़) mein lamba 'ई'. Dono ko alag bolna practice karo — dheere (slow) suno.

blocks.why: Ek vyakti = this. Plural ke saath these + are.

lessons.title: have, has, there is / there are

blocks.x: **Mere paas hai** = **I have**. Hindi ka 'ke paas' English mein **have/has** ban jata hai. He/She/It ke saath **has**, baaki sab ke saath **have**.
Negative aur question (do/does ke saath)

items.en: She does not have a bike.

blocks.x: there is / there are — 'wahan hai'
Kisi jagah par kuch **hone** ki baat: ek cheez = **there is**, kai cheezein = **there are**.

items.en: There is a book on the table.
Is there a bank near here?
items.hi: क्या यहाँ पास में बैंक है?

blocks.why: She/He/It ke saath has.
Plural ke saath there are.

quiz.q: There ___ five students in the class.

lessons.title: can, cannot, must, should
lessons.hi: Kar sakna, karna chahiye, karna hi hai

5 aadatein jo sabse zyada kaam karti hain

**1. Shadowing:** koi sentence suno, turant saath mein bolo. Phir record karo aur compare karo.
**2. Khud se baat karo:** din bhar jo kar rahe ho, English mein bolo. 'I am making tea. I am pouring water.'
**3. Diary:** roz 3 sentence likho — aaj kya kiya. Galti ki chinta mat karo.
**4. English mein sochna:** Hindi se translate mat karo, seedhe chhote sentence socho.
**5. Roz karo:** 30 minute roz, 3 ghante haftey mein ek baar se behtar hai.

lessons.title: Understanding fast English: contractions and linking
lessons.hi: Log tez kyon bolte hain, samajh kaise aaye

blocks.x: Jab log English tez bolte hain to sunne mein shabd mile-jule lagte hain. Iska raaz: **contractions** (chhote roop) aur **linking** (shabd jud jaate hain). Ye jaan lo to sunna aasan ho jata hai.
Contractions
Linking: shabd jud jaate hain
Ye informal bolchaal hai. Likhne mein 'going to', 'want to' hi likho. Par jab koi 'gonna' ya 'wanna' bole to samajh jao ki wo kya keh raha hai.
Practice kaise karein
Koi bhi chhoti video ya podcast lagao, **subtitles ke saath** ek sentence suno aur dobara 5 baar suno. Phir bina subtitles ke suno. Roz 10 minute.
